title: Sandisk Stock (SNDK) Falls 22.3% as Chip Stocks Slide (Nov 5)
summary: Sandisk (SNDK) fell 22.26% to $806.43 on Nov 5 as AI and chip stocks sold off on fears that stricter regulation could slow data center construction.
body_markdown:
Memory and chip peers also fell hard.[Micron (MU)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) dropped 17.46% to $656.39,[Advanced Micro Devices (AMD)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) fell 17.26% to $404.40 and[Nvidia (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) lost 9.26% to $181.60. At the close, Sandisk sat 65.75% below its 52-week high of $2,354.39 and 340.67% above its 52-week low of $183.00.


## Why Sandisk Stock Fell


Financial media did not tie the drop to company-specific news; they linked it to a sector-wide selloff in chip and AI stocks. According to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/qualcomm-micron-arm-stocks-sink-lead-chip-sector-lower-133100607.html) , chip stocks fell on Thursday, extending[declines from the prior session](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-5-2026/) , "amid the threat that stricter regulation could slow data center construction." The same report said Sandisk's slide extended a 7% decline in the prior session.


As reported by[TheStreet](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sandisk-stock-plunges-20-ai-220804188.html) , investors worried about the future of data center expansion after Democrats swept both chambers of Congress and won key gubernatorial races in Tuesday's midterm elections, raising fears that tighter oversight could slow AI data center construction.


The selloff came a week after Sandisk's latest[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) . According to the company's[October 29 release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2023554/000162828026068243/sndkq1-27ex991xpressrelease.htm) , fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue was $11.0 billion, up 23% sequentially, with non-GAAP diluted earnings of $49.51 per share. TheStreet reported that both figures topped analyst estimates of $10.70 billion in revenue and $46.41 per share.


## SNDK Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Datacenter revenue reached $4,802 million in fiscal Q1, up 61% from the previous quarter, according to the company's release.
- Sandisk guided for fiscal second-quarter 2027 revenue of $12.2 billion to $12.6 billion and non-GAAP earnings of $55.00 to $57.00 per share on a pre-split basis, per the same release.
- The company returned $5.0 billion to stockholders by repurchasing approximately 3.2 million shares during the quarter, the release said.


### Risks


- Financial media linked the selloff to fears that stricter regulation could slow AI data center construction, while TheStreet noted that AI demand for storage has been pushing NAND prices higher, lifting Sandisk's revenue and margins.
- Pressure spread across memory makers, with Yahoo Finance reporting declines at Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics alongside Sandisk.
- Yahoo Finance noted that semiconductor stocks have been volatile since the summer, and Sandisk closed 65.75% below its 52-week high.


Sandisk's eight-for-one forward stock split takes effect on November 19, 2026, according to the company's release, which said the split is meant to make the stock more accessible, including to employees.
